e: A historic meeting of the leaders of the four constituent members of the Realm of New Zealand to discuss constitutional arrangements is held in Auckland. This meeting is attended by Prime Minister Tagelagi, New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, Ulu-o-Tokelau Alapati Tavite, and Cook Islands Prime Minister Mark Brown.
Fiji-based retail chain, CJS Supermarket, expands into Niue through the purchase of the country's largest supermarket, Swanson.
Germany formally recognizes and establishes diplomatic relations with Niue, coordinating ties from the embassy in Wellington, New Zealand.
